rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already has decor/furniture editors, Properties colours, device faces and dialog forms. Apply the accepted UI kit to these existing workflows, preserve their writers/history, and correct selection/cursor feedback; this is an improvement to stable surfaces rather than an entirely new subsystem.

summary.ru: Единые панели и меню редакторов, свойства мебели и прямой ввод цвета с предпросмотром; понятное выделение устройств и курсор плана.
summary.en: Consistent editor trays and menus, furniture properties and inline colour preview, with clearer device selection and Plan cursor feedback.
